description: Performance play ordered by the Team Lead: the gate page is every guest's first page, so Home's wall must reuse THE SAME full-color image file as the gate background, recreating the accepted 35%-over-cream muting via CSS (an opacity/blend layer over token cream) instead of the separately-baked public/pattern/wall-tile.webp — so the main-page background is already browser-cached when guests pass the gate. This also resolves the recorded advisory that wall-tile.webp bakes the literal cream #ECDFD1: the CSS-over-token muting replaces the bake.
title: Home wall sources the gate's cached full-color image
acceptance_criteria: The gate and Home reference one identical image URL — verifiable in the network panel: one fetch, the second page served from cache
Home's rendered wall is visually equivalent to the accepted 35%-over-cream treatment
wall-tile.webp is removed or marked retired in docs/pattern-assets.md
The muting layer colors come from theme tokens
